title: DongCheng Electric 10 mm Drill Machine Kit with 13pcs HSS Drill Bit Set, Carbon Brush Pair, Screw Bit & Multipurpose Drill Bit for Wood Metal Wall Home Use
description: The DongCheng Electric Drill Machine Combo Kit is designed to support everyday drilling and fixing requirements for home, workshop, and DIY applications. This electric drill offers steady performance for drilling in wood, metal, plastic, and light wall surfaces, making it suitable for general repair and installation work. This drill machine kit comes with useful accessories to help complete different tasks efficiently. The 13pcs HSS drill bit set provides multiple size options for accurate drilling in various materials. A multipurpose drill bit and a screw bit are also included, allowing both drilling and screw driving operations without the need to buy extra tools separately. For maintenance support, the kit includes one pair of carbon brushes, which helps extend the usability of the drill motor. The ergonomic handle ensures a comfortable grip, while the compact and lightweight design allows better control during extended use. This DongCheng drill machine set is suitable for home users, electricians, technicians, and DIY enthusiasts who need a dependable drilling solution. Whether you are assembling furniture, fixing wall fixtures, or handling basic repair jobs, this combo kit provides essential tools in one package.
